messages:
Mia Chen: Quick check — we need a rollforward checklist for the default-model flip next week. What's the minimal API contract verification we should run? (accept-model header, pin fallback, response shape, error codes)
Anya Patel: Minimal smoke list:
• ensure Accept-Model / X-Accept-Model header is honored
• calling without header keeps current unpinned behavior
• streaming frames and final envelope unchanged
• error codes (429/503/500) are identical and no new 4xx
Sam Ortiz: SDK note: current JS SDK auto-pins to server default when no model arg is passed. That will surprise users if default changes. I can add opt-in auto-pin toggle in v0.9.6.
Sam Ortiz: Example header we'll test:
```
Accept-Model: gpt-open-2026
```
Leo Park: Timeline question — docs & CS need 10 business days for migration content. We should do canary -> monitor 48h -> ramp.
Jon Reyes: Docs + migration snippet I'll own. Will post a short snippet and example client migration.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot deployed canary: model-default-rollfwd-1 to us-west-2 (canary=10%) :rocket:
Sam Ortiz: Quick smoke I ran against canary:
`curl -i -H "Accept-Model: gpt-open-2026" https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate` returns 200, body schema unchanged, top-level `model` value differs.
Anya Patel: For contract tests I'll add an integration matrix: [streaming|non-streaming] x [Accept-Model present|absent] x [pinned client|unpinned client]
Mia Chen: Proposed rollforward checklist (short):
1) Contract smoke on canary (schema & error codes)
2) SDK integration matrix (Anya owns)
3) Docs + CS migration note (Jon owns)
4) Canary monitor 48h metrics: latency, token cost, generation quality (eval set)
5) Ramp: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with manual gate on regressions
6) Post-roll announcement + changelog
Anya Patel: I'll own SDK tests and shim PR. @Sam Ortiz can you review the shim when ready?
Sam Ortiz: Yup, I'll review. PR: https://github.com/redwood/clients/pull/987
Jon Reyes: Added an Optimize eval watch to track quality drift on our canonical prompts. Will alert Slack #eng-ml if thresholds hit.
Leo Park: One more: add a feature-flag to force old-model behavior for support debug. If we need rollback it's instant.
Mia Chen: Good call. I'll add feature flag + toggle in the console & a short rollback playbook. I'll post the canned message for CS to send. :thumbsup:
Sam Ortiz: tiny nit — make sure streaming chunk boundaries include model id header when we log for audits.
Mia Chen: noted. Thanks all. I'll send an async announcement 30 min before the first ramp and update the checklist doc: https://intranet.redwood.dev/rollforwards/default-model
Anya Patel: :eyes: moving the SDK ticket to In Review.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot canary health: ok (no 5xx in last 30m).
